index.layout: Header banner with logo, horizontal nav bar, breadcrumb toolbar, then stacked category tables listing sub-forums with icon/title/desc, threads, posts, last post columns; right sidebar shows online users, birthdays, and a banner ad.

subforum.layout: Breadcrumb and New Thread button on top, then a wide table of threads with columns for icon, title+starter, replies, views, last post; sticky threads pinned at top with cream background, pagination at bottom.

thread.layout: Breadcrumb plus Reply/New Thread buttons, then a vertical stack of 15 post cards each with a left sidebar (avatar, username, rank, post count, join date, rep) and right post body with quotes, images, and italic signature divided by hr.

profile.layout: Two-column profile page: left column with large avatar, username, rank, contact buttons; right column with tabbed stats panel, about me, recent posts list, and awards/infractions grid.

search.layout: Centered search form panel with keyword, username, date range, forum selector, and sort radio buttons, followed by quick-link buttons for Today's Posts and New Posts, then a results table styled like the subforum thread list.
